new_statements.quote: But no other industry has the potential to fundamentally change the nature of the social contract, or cause human demise to the level that AI is offering.
new_statements.context: Explaining why he backs public ownership and utility-style regulation of AI companies, answering critics who call that too intense.
new_statements.reason: Says in his own words that AI has the potential to cause human demise, a threat to humanity (ruling 1).

new_statements.venue: Statement reported by Common Dreams (said Wednesday; medium not stated, possibly his social media video)

new_statements.reason: Says AI products that slip human control could mean the demise of humanity.
